current_ha_dev.authority: Do not substitute stable/latest tag or later Speech main without separate delivery authority

phases: Choose and authorize target host plus a bounded HA-dev interruption. Pi receiver colocation is a scope change from exposing the existing Mac port. A dedicated Linux host/bridged VM is an alternative, not yet provisioned; Mac/EP_DATA currently lack room for an unplanned VM.

Before mutation coordinate Core/resource leases; pin exact existing HA OCI digest and installed Core artifact; record source container configuration and restart policy, client local/remote origins and provider endpoints without publishing secrets. Ensure a stable target LAN address and deliberate IPv4/IPv6 reachability policy; no blanket gateway allowlist.

Prepare consistent private backup of complete HA configuration/storage and data, including Profile/pairing fingerprints. Keep credentials only in private backup/SSH transfer, never Git/logs. Do not drop databases/history merely to reduce copied bytes. Verify archive/checksums and restore instructions before cutover.

Prepare target runtime/storage with kiosk resource limits and no automatic parallel HA startup. Reconfigure only the three HA dependency endpoints through supported HA configuration procedures, retaining entry identities/authentication; do not patch live .storage blindly. Existing Mac MA/Wyoming containers remain in place.

At cutover stop only Mac HA-dev cleanly and suppress its auto-restart for the agreed window, preserving original container/config and policy for rollback. Start exactly one target HA instance from the consistent copy and exact image. Do not run two live installations with the same pairing/Profile/provider identity. Repoint the existing external TLS tunnel and explicitly configured client local origin only through an agreed supported path preserving paired installation identity; no re-pair/reset or certificate bypass.

Before local actions require real iPad socket-peer/interface evidence and Core-owned operator qualification bound to exact installation/origin/interface/expiry; then independently validate HTTP context and WS auth_ok. Run real LAN/external/LAN, original-operation status, background and UI-state preservation checks. Qualify provider dependencies and kiosk responsiveness separately. TCP/health200 is not full acceptance.
rollback: Stop target HA before any old instance resumes. Restore original remote tunnel/client configured origins and original Mac HA container restart policy; start original unchanged Mac config/runtime. Verify original paired installation/Profile fingerprints, HA health, dependencies and kiosk. Remove only newly created test resources after readback, preserving backup and receipts.

apple_origin_change_audit.status: SOURCE_READBACK_ONLY; no client configuration or runtime change
findings: apply(pairingResponse:fallbackBaseURL:) persists local and remote origins, but its only production call found is the pair operation.
localHomeAssistantURL() prioritizes persisted haLocalURL over editable homeAssistantURL; changing the latter alone cannot reliably rebind an existing paired client.
pinLocalHomeAssistantURLIfNeeded runs only after a local connection has already succeeded, so it cannot discover an unknown new local origin.
Command response application reads installation/bootstrap and backend summary but does not apply response.haLocalURL/haRemoteURL.
Existing hybrid coordinator is keyed by configured local/remote origins plus installation and device IDs. Do not bypass that trust boundary by injecting a new URL or editing app-private defaults.
apple_origin_change_audit.required_before_cutover: Confirm an existing supported paired-origin rebind path or separately deliver and qualify one preserving installID/Profile/token, trusted external recovery and operation reconciliation. Source inspection alone does not establish native migration acceptance.
apple_origin_change_audit.alternative_to_evaluate: Stable existing client hostname routed directly to chosen Linux host, if already configured and operator-controlled; current IP-based origins cannot be assumed to follow DNS. No DNS/IP takeover authorized or performed.
